rules.scope: reference runtime configuration, genesis, test, benchmark, and TryRuntime panic ownership
patterns: serialization to json is expected to work
native balances must be a JSON array
asset accounts must be a JSON array
relay reserve asset registration must succeed
registered relay reserve deposit must succeed
well-known protocol asset metadata must exist
Liquidity Actor contract_steps fits within MaxContractSteps
BLDR splitter contract_steps fits within MaxContractSteps
BLDR Liquidity Actor contract_steps fits within MaxContractSteps
native staking liquidity activation checks staked asset first
native staking liquidity execution plan fits within MaxContractSteps
Treasury B buyback contract_steps fits within MaxContractSteps
benchmark native account funding must succeed
rules.rationale: TryRuntime deliberately traps failed checks; ChainSpec/genesis builders fail before launch; XCM conversion and reserve assertions are file-local tests; benchmark setup fails measurement rather than consensus; runtime Actor catalog plans are fixed-size constructions covered by pallet integrity bounds. Any differently worded runtime site is unowned and fails the full-tree audit.
rules.expiry: Replace an entry when the site becomes typed failure or when its TryRuntime, construction, test, benchmark, or bounded-catalog owner changes.
